entities.summary: Quavious Keyate Marshall, better known by his stage name Quavo, is an American rapper and record producer. He was the frontman of the now-defunct hip-hop group Migos. Formed with his nephew Takeoff and their mutual friend Offset in 2008, the group released four commercially successful studio albums before disbanding in 2023.
